rot.ponte.demos.ataque.1: Attack: the position from the idea, with the rook already on d4. This time Black does not wait with the rook: the black king, on e6, comes to attack your rook.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.10: Your king recaptures: the pawn is gone, but your rook stays, and rook against a lone king wins.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.2: The king leaves b8 via c7 and keeps protecting the pawn.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.4: The king goes to b6, next to the pawn.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.5: Defence: another check, now along the b-file.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.6: The king goes to c6, still protecting the pawn.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.7: Defence: instead of another check, the black king goes to e5 and attacks the rook on d4.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.8: The rook slides along the fourth rank to c4: away from the black king and out of reach of the black rook. Not every square will do: on b4, the black rook captures it; on e4 or f4, the black king captures it.
rot.ponte.demos.ataque.9: Defence: the pawn threatens to promote on b8, and the black rook gives itself up for it.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.1: Attack: now the pawn is on c7. Your rook is already on the fourth rank, on e4, and shuts the e-file: the black king stays on the far side.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.10: The rook blocks on c4, protected by the king: the bridge is built, and the checks are over.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.11: Defence: with no checks left, the black rook captures on c4, with check.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.12: The king recaptures, and the black king cannot catch the pawn: it promotes on the next move.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.2: The king leaves c8 via d7 and keeps protecting the pawn.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.3: Defence: the black rook starts checking along the d-file, to drive the king away from the pawn.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.4: The king goes to c6, still next to the pawn.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.6: The king leaves the c-file via d6 and keeps protecting the pawn.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.7: Defence: another check, now along the d-file.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.8: The king comes down to c5, just above the fourth rank. The rook can now step onto the c-file.
rot.ponte.demos.quarta.9: Defence: one more check along the c-file.
rot.ponte.demos.quinta.1: Defence: now let us think from Black's side. Here the white rook went to the fifth rank, to d5, next to your king on e6.
rot.ponte.demos.quinta.2: The rook captures the pawn! If the white king recaptures, it stops protecting the rook on d5.
rot.ponte.demos.quinta.3: The white king recaptures and moves away from the rook.
rot.ponte.demos.quinta.4: Your king captures the rook: a draw. With the rook on d4, away from your king, this resource would not exist.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.b8c7.1: Attack: this wins too, but the king steps out before the rook is ready, and the black rook starts checking at once.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.b8c7.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.b8c8.1: Attack: this wins too, but the king steps out before the rook is ready, and the black rook starts checking at once.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.b8c8.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1b1.1: Attack: this wins too, but the rook leaves the d-file, and the black king gets a path to the pawn.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1b1.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1c1.1: Attack: this wins too, but the rook leaves the d-file, and the black king gets a path to the pawn.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1c1.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1d3.1: Attack: this wins too: on the third rank the rook also blocks the checks, but your king has to come down one rank further to reach it.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1d3.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1d5.1: Attack: this wins too, but on the fifth rank the rook is too close to the black king: it comes to e6 and attacks it at once. On the fourth rank, the rook stands one rank further from it.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1d5.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1e1.1: Attack: this wins too, but the rook leaves the d-file, and the black king gets a path to the pawn.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1e1.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.

rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.alt.d1h1.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the rook on the fourth rank.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.certo: Attack: the rook goes to the fourth rank, to d4, and keeps shutting the d-file. Later, it will block the last check.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: this is the Lucena position. The pawn is on the seventh rank, your king stands in front of it, on b8, and your rook shuts the d-file: the black king, on e7, cannot reach the pawn.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.e2: The problem is your king: it must leave b8 for the pawn to promote, but the black rook, on a2, gives checks from afar as soon as it steps out. How do you prepare the exit?
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1a1.1: Attack: the rook goes to a1, on the black rook's file and unprotected.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1a1.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the black rook captures yours, and the pawn alone cannot win: a draw.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d2.1: Attack: the rook goes to d2, on the black rook's rank and unprotected.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the black rook captures yours, and the pawn alone cannot win: a draw.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d6.1: Attack: the rook goes to d6, next to the black king and unprotected.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d6.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the black king captures the rook, and the pawn alone cannot win: a draw.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d7.1: Attack: the rook checks on d7, but it stands next to the black king, unprotected.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d7.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the black king captures the rook, and the pawn alone cannot win: a draw.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d8.1: Attack: the rook goes to d8, next to the black king and unprotected.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.err.d1d8.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the black king captures the rook, and the pawn alone cannot win: a draw.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.fora: That move is not among the ones we study here. Back to the position.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l0: With the rook on d4, your king can now leave b8. Watch how the checks come to an end.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l1: Defence: the black rook waits on a1, far from your king, ready to check along the files as soon as it steps out.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l10: The rook blocks the check on b4, protected by the king: that is the bridge. Building the bridge means this: the rook on the fourth rank closes the path of the checks.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l11: Defence: with no checks left, the black rook captures on b4, with check, to at least remove your rook.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l12: Your king recaptures, and the black king is too far away: the pawn promotes on the next move.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l2: The king leaves b8 via c7 and keeps protecting the pawn. The black king stays on the far side of the d-file.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l3: Defence: check along the c-file. The black rook will keep checking to drive your king away from the pawn.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l4: The king comes down to b6, next to the pawn, towards the fourth rank, where your rook stands.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l5: Defence: another check, now along the b-file.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l6: The king goes to c6, still protecting the pawn, and leaves the b-file.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l7: Defence: check again along the c-file.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l8: The king comes down to b5, just above the fourth rank. Now the rook can step in between it and the black rook.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.l9: Defence: one more check along the b-file.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.p: Attack: think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.revela: Attack: the plan is to bring the rook to the fourth rank, to d4, without leaving the d-file. Later, it will block the last check.
rot.ponte.ideia.ex1.volta: Back to the position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.ponte.pratica.err.coroa.1: The pawn promoted on a square watched by the black rook: it captures the new piece, and rook against rook is a draw.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.coroa.2: Before promoting, check whether the black rook reaches the promotion square. If it does, first close its path with your rook or king.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.desprotege.1: Your king moved away from the rook, and it was left unprotected: Black captures it, and the pawn alone cannot win.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.desprotege.2: Before moving the king, check that the rook stays protected or out of reach of the black pieces.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.pendurada.1: Your rook was within reach of the black king, and the move did not take it away: the king captures it, and the pawn alone cannot win.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.pendurada.2: Before each move, check whether the black king attacks your rook. If it does, take care of it first.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.desvio.1: The black rook gives itself up for the pawn: when your king recaptures, your rook is left unprotected, within reach of the black king, and it is a draw.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.desvio.2: Before moving the rook, check that it stays safe after an exchange on the pawn.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.menor.1: The pawn became a bishop or a knight, and rook and minor piece against rook is usually a draw.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.menor.2: When you promote, choose a queen.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.peao.1: The pawn is unprotected: the black rook wins it, and rook against rook is a draw.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.peao.2: Keep the king next to the pawn until it promotes, and leave the checks for the rook to block.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.rei.1: The rook went to a square next to the black king, unprotected: the king captures it, and the pawn alone cannot win.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.rei.2: Keep the rook away from the black king, or protected by your king. If the black king attacks it, slide the rook along the rank without giving it up.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.torre.1: The rook went to a square within reach of the black rook, unprotected: the black rook captures it, and the pawn alone cannot win.
rot.ponte.pratica.err.torre.2: Before each rook move, check whether the new square is within reach of the black rook. To block a check, the rook must be protected by your king.
rot.ponte.pratica.fins.afogado: Draw: the black king is stalemated. Before each move, check that the black king still has a free square.
rot.ponte.pratica.fins.insuficiente: The rook and the pawn left the board, and the material is not enough: a draw. Before each move, check whether the rook is within reach of the black king or rook.
rot.ponte.pratica.fins.limite: The move limit ran out before the pawn promoted. First the rook goes to the fourth rank; then the king steps out and the rook blocks the last check.
rot.ponte.pratica.fins.repeticao: Draw by repetition. Instead of going back to the same position, bring the rook to the fourth rank and get the king out of g8.
rot.ponte.pratica.lado.fim: End of the chapter: in the Lucena position, the rook goes to the fourth rank, the king steps out, and the rook blocks the last check. That is building the bridge.
rot.ponte.pratica.lado.p: Attack: the pawn is on g7, and your rook shuts the e-file. Build the bridge and promote the pawn. If the black rook watches the promotion square, cover that square before you promote.
